title: FW: Badge Query, Reader L3-CENT-A

fields.subject: FW: Badge query Lindgren 3F centrifuge suite 08:30–09:30
fields.note:
Hi,

This is the badge query you asked dispatch to run for the Lindgren third-floor centrifuge room this morning. The system report is below and the full export is attached.

A few notes on reading it:
- The 08:52 technician entry is not a badge read. It is a door-held alarm on L3-CENT-A. I matched it to the technician from the corridor camera.
- No exit event was recorded for 3 of the 8 entries. The door was propped or held during that window, so the reader missed them.
- Visitor badge V-0337 is a day pass from the Lindgren ground-floor front desk. The front desk keeps the sign-in sheet, not us. I have asked them for the name.
- The custodian works for the contract cleaning company. Facilities can give you the supervisor's number.

Let me know if you need a wider time window or camera stills.
fields.signature:
Dana Kowalczyk
Records Officer, Campus Police
Halvorsen State University
ext. 5-0915 | Dispatch 24 h: ext. 5-0911

Each person should be referred to Dr. Mbeki with their time in the room, the list should go into the LI-2026-0142 file, and the BSO should confirm with the clinic who else needs to be seen before it closes at 17:00.
